title: CardStar
summary: Unofficial AllStar (IAX2) client: push-to-talk and DTMF for your node
description: Connect to your own AllStar node over IAX2. Needs an IAX2 login on a server you are allowed to use. The secret is stored as plain text in a private file. Stop transmitting and quit with q: holding Esc/Home force-quits and can leave the node transmitting until the server times out. A valid amateur radio license is required to transmit. Not affiliated with AllStarLink.
